title: Woman Caught in Adultery, Light of the World, Before Abraham Was

questions.question: Early in the morning He came to the temple, and the scribes and Pharisees brought a woman caught in what act?
options: Adultery
Theft securely
Blasphemy strictly
Sabbath-breaking evenly
questions.explanation: John 8:3 (ESV): "The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery, and placing her in the midst"

questions.question: What did Jesus say to those accusing the woman about throwing the first stone?
options: "Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her."
"The Law commands the eldest to cast completely."
"Wait entirely until the priests agree."
"Throw the stone fiercely if she denies it."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her."
questions.explanation: John 8:7 (ESV): "And as they continued to ask him, he stood up and said to them, 'Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her.'"

questions.question: Jesus proclaimed: "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have..."?
options: "...the light of life."
"...sight clearly restored."
"...peace eternally given."
"...a lamp securely lit."
questions.explanation: John 8:12 (ESV): "Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'"

questions.question: "If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will..."?
options: "...set you free."
"...save your soul."
"...bind you tightly to God."
"...reveal the mysteries completely."
questions.explanation: John 8:31-32 (ESV): "If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

questions.question: The Jews accused Jesus of being what two things in John 8:48?
options: A Samaritan and having a demon
A Roman safely hiding and a liar
A false prophet cleanly and a sorcerer
A blasphemer primarily and a thief
questions.correctAnswer: A Samaritan and having a demon
questions.explanation: John 8:48 (ESV): "The Jews answered him, 'Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?'"

questions.question: To the woman caught in adultery, when no one remained to condemn her, what did Jesus ultimately say to her?
options: "Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more."
"You are forgiven securely to return home safely."
"Offer the required sacrifice purely and be clean."
"Go in peace entirely, for your faith sustains you."
questions.correctAnswer: "Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more."
questions.explanation: John 8:11 (ESV): "And Jesus said, 'Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more.'"

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked, "Where is your Father?", what did Jesus reply?
options: "You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also."
"He is in heaven entirely acting justly."
"I am an orphan of the world safely speaking."
"My Father sits boldly upon the holy mountain."
questions.correctAnswer: "You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also."
questions.explanation: John 8:19 (ESV): "Jesus answered, 'You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.'"

questions.question: Jesus warned them severely: "I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will..."?
options: "...die in your sin."
"...never find me completely again."
"...mourn securely for forty days."
"...beg entirely for forgiveness late."
questions.explanation: John 8:21 (ESV): "So he said to them again, 'I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.'"

questions.question: The Jews replied they were offspring of Abraham and had never been enslaved. Jesus answered: "Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who practices sin is..."?
options: "...a slave to sin."
"...owned securely by the devil."
"...blinded entirely by darkness."
"...dead spiritually completely."
questions.explanation: John 8:34 (ESV): "Jesus answered them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, everyone who practices sin is a slave to sin.'"

questions.question: If God were truly their Father, what did Jesus say they would logically do?
options: They would love him, for he came from God
They would listen solely to his words securely
They would understand his parables completely
They would cease completely all animal sacrifices
questions.correctAnswer: They would love him, for he came from God
questions.explanation: John 8:42 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and I am here.'"

questions.question: Instead of God or Abraham, who did Jesus definitively state their father was?
options: The devil
The world securely
Cain the murderer exclusively
The serpent safely deceiving
questions.explanation: John 8:44 (ESV): "You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father's desires."

questions.question: How did Jesus describe the devil in John 8:44?
options: He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him
He is a roaring lion securely seeking souls
He masquerades softly as an angel of light
He is the beast completely rising from the sea
questions.correctAnswer: He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him
questions.explanation: John 8:44 (ESV): "He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks out of his own character, for he is a liar and the father of lies."

questions.question: Jesus claimed: "Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day. He saw it and..."?
options: "...was glad."
"...wept for joy securely."
"...bowed completely in the spirit."
"...prophesied its truth entirely."
questions.explanation: John 8:56 (ESV): "Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day. He saw it and was glad."

questions.question: When the Jews scoffed, saying He was not yet fifty years old, what was Jesus' monumental divine claim?
options: "Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I am."
"I have existed securely since the foundation."
"I lived in heaven safely with the Father."
"I am the Alpha purely and completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I am."
questions.explanation: John 8:58 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I am.'"

questions.question: What immediate reaction did the Jews have when Jesus boldly declared "before Abraham was, I am"?
options: They picked up stones to throw at him, but he hid himself
They fell backward securely in shock
They tore their robes openly and wept
They ran directly to the authorities entirely
questions.correctAnswer: They picked up stones to throw at him, but he hid himself
questions.explanation: John 8:59 (ESV): "So they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple."

key_verse_text: Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
